env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
# An escaping fork-only method value has no upstream spelling. Only
# direct calls have the explicit extended-CONNECT rewrite.
logos build ./...
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'server\.lgo:6.*fork_stdlib_api.*EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect'
! exists out

cd ../expression
logos build ./...
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'server\.lgo:5.*fork_stdlib_api.*EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect'
! exists out

cd ../wrapper
# A file that defines the method itself is skipped by the text rewrite,
# so its delegate call to the real method must not be exempted either:
# approving it would emit code upstream Go rejects. Eject fails here
# instead of writing the unrewritten call.
logos build ./...
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'server\.lgo:10.*fork_stdlib_api.*EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect'
! exists out

cd ../rawimport
# A raw net/http import literal names the same path the decoded emitter
# accepts, so the direct call keeps its exemption and ejects.
logos build ./...
logos eject -o out
exists out/server.go
! grep 'EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect' out/server.go
cd ../ok
# The stock-library control ejects cleanly.
logos build ./...
logos eject -o out
exists out/server.go

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/h2portability

go 1.27

-- m/server.lgo --
package h2portability

import "net/http"

func Enable(s *http.Server) func() {
	return s.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect
}

-- expression/go.mod --
module example.com/h2expression

go 1.27

-- expression/server.lgo --
package h2expression

import "net/http"

var Enable = (*http.Server).EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect

-- ok/go.mod --
module example.com/h2ok

go 1.27

-- ok/server.lgo --
package h2ok

import "net/http"

func KeepAlive(s *http.Server) {
	s.SetKeepAlivesEnabled(true)
}

-- wrapper/go.mod --
module example.com/h2wrapper

go 1.27

-- wrapper/server.lgo --
package h2wrapper

import "net/http"

type Server struct {
	*http.Server
}

func (s *Server) EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect() {
	s.Server.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
}

-- rawimport/go.mod --
module example.com/h2rawimport

go 1.27

-- rawimport/server.lgo --
package h2rawimport

import `net/http`

func Enable(s *http.Server) {
	s.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
}
